First release of Multiverse FC, an incremental football manager.

- Start as a Sunday League club and climb eleven leagues to the Multiverse Premier, within 100 years and without going bankrupt.
- League and cup every season, promotion and relegation.
- Squad, transfers, six levelled training drills, seven facilities, tickets, sponsors, wages and loans.
- Every run that ends earns shards for permanent Nexus upgrades and an echo boost for all later runs.

Download Multiverse-FC-Launcher.exe, put it in its own folder and run it. It installs the game next to itself and keeps it up to date. Your saves are kept between updates.
